RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias or discrimination. Hiring decisions at senior levels typically hinge on interview performance and specific operational needs—such as the successful candidate's international project leadership—rather than degrees or tenure alone. 

Raising gender bias without concrete evidence will appear unprofessional and could damage your reputation within the civil service. Delays of two weeks for HR feedback are also routine in government ministries. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your feedback, framed around personal development and interview performance. Only reconsider formal escalation if the written debrief or selection records demonstrate clear procedural irregularities or discriminatory criteria.
